FISHING LICENCE · CANADA

British Columbia fishing licence

Visitors aged 16 and older need a provincial freshwater licence. Tidal waters require a separate federal licence at every age.

Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Freshwater anglers aged 16 and older.
  • All tidal anglers, including children.

Who doesn’t

  • Visiting freshwater anglers under 16 can share an accompanying licence holder's quota.
  • Children under 16 need a tidal licence, but the basic licence is free.

Extra stamps and permits

  • Tidal salmon conservation stamp · $7.39 CAD
    Required at every age to retain tidal salmon.
  • Freshwater species stamps and conservation licences
    Required for specified species and activities; consult the provincial licence page.
  • Class I Classified Waters licence · $45.72 CAD
    Required per day for visiting anglers on Class I waters.
  • Class II Classified Waters licence · $22.86 CAD
    Required per day for visiting anglers on Class II waters.

Saltwater

DFO issues tidal licences through the National Recreational Licensing System. Tidal and freshwater salmon stamps are separate.

Fishing with a guide or charter

Guides can buy freshwater licences for clients. Confirm that the guide obtained your individual licences.

Rules visitors should know

  • Carry the applicable licence.
  • Foreign visitors targeting halibut in Areas 23, 121 and 123 must buy the tidal licence from a vendor in Canada.
  • Record retained chinook and halibut immediately, plus lingcod in the specified areas.
  • Adult tidal licence holders must complete their assigned iREC report.

How to buy

Buy freshwater licences through WILD or a provincial vendor. Buy tidal licences through DFO's National Recreational Licensing System or a vendor.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in British Columbia?

Visitors aged 16 and older need a provincial freshwater licence. Tidal waters require a separate federal licence at every age.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in British Columbia?

Freshwater Canadian visitor annual: $62.87 CAD; Freshwater foreign visitor annual: $91.44 CAD; Freshwater visitor 1-day: $22.86 CAD; Freshwater Canadian visitor 8-day: $41.15 CAD (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in British Columbia?

Buy freshwater licences through WILD or a provincial vendor. Buy tidal licences through DFO's National Recreational Licensing System or a vendor.
